newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul exchange to list Sabanci Hldg shares.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul exchange to list Sabanci Hldg shares.

text.p: The Istanbul Stock Exchange said it would list publicly-owned shares of Haci Omer Sabanci Holding, one of Turkey's leading industrial conglomerates, on the national market at an opening price of 5,400 lira per 1.000 lira nominal-value on Tuesday.

The company had last week floated five trillion lira ($33.3 million) of new shares, or 10 percent of its capital, in a two-day public offer while doubling its capital to 50 trillion lira from 25 trillion.

Yatirim Finansman, a member of the consortium that managed the offer, said 4.5 trillion lira, or 90 percent of the offer, was sold to 95 foreign institutions, 450 billion lira of it to 112,182 individual investors and 50 billion lira to 67 domestic institutions.
Yatirim Finansman also declared that none of the buyers got more than five percent of the offered stake.
Sabanci Holding announced last week that its share offers in both international and domestic markets were heavily oversubscribed.

A total demand of $263 million was received from more than 100 investors for the foreign sale worth around $170 million. A 7.2 trillion lira demand was received for the 2.7-trillion-lira worth domestic sale.
